intro: C2 es la maestría: estructuras que solo usan los hablantes cultos, modismos que no se traducen, participios que condensan ideas, concesivas y hipotéticas de matiz, cohesión de texto y la precisión de quien elige cada palabra. Diez lecciones y un examen con el temario de los exámenes oficiales de nivel C2.
goals: Usar el subjuntivo y las estructuras formales (I suggest that he be…, lest, whether… or not).
Entender y emplear modismos y lenguaje figurado frecuentes.
Condensar ideas con participios y oraciones reducidas (Having finished…, Seen from above…).
Elegir con precisión: matices entre sinónimos y lenguaje académico.
Conceder con much as, however hard y no matter.
Hablar de lo hipotético con it's time, would sooner, as if y as though.
Dar cohesión a un texto con referencia y sustitución formal.
Usar binomios, colocaciones avanzadas y énfasis formal (the very, whatsoever).

lessons.title: El subjuntivo y las estructuras formales
lessons.summary: I suggest that he be informed: el verbo en forma base tras ciertos verbos y adjetivos.

sections.heading: El subjuntivo tras suggest, demand, insist
body: Tras verbos como suggest, recommend, demand, insist, request, propose y tras adjetivos como essential, vital, important, se usa that + sujeto + verbo en forma base (sin -s ni to): I suggest that he see a doctor. It is essential that every member be present. La negación es not + verbo: that she not be disturbed.
En inglés británico se oye también should: I suggest that he should see a doctor.

examples.en: The doctor recommended that she rest for a week.
examples.es: El médico recomendó que descansara una semana.

examples.en: It is vital that the report be finished today.
examples.es: Es vital que el informe se termine hoy.

examples.en: They demanded that the manager resign.
examples.es: Exigieron que el director dimitiera.

examples.en: I insist that he not be told.
examples.es: Insisto en que no se le diga.

examples.en: The judge ordered that the evidence be sealed.
examples.es: El juez ordenó que las pruebas se sellaran.

examples.en: It is imperative that we act now.
examples.es: Es imperativo que actuemos ya.

rows: I propose that we leave now.
They require that applicants be over 18.
It is essential / vital / crucial that
It is crucial that she attend.
We ask that you remain seated.

sections.heading: Fórmulas fijas y were
body: Expresiones hechas con subjuntivo: so be it (que así sea), God save the King, be that as it may (sea como sea), far be it from me (lejos de mí), come what may (pase lo que pase). Were en hipótesis formales: if I were, were he to accept (si aceptara), as it were (por así decirlo).

examples.en: Be that as it may, we must continue.
examples.es: Sea como sea, debemos continuar.

examples.en: Were he to resign, the company would struggle.
examples.es: Si él dimitiera, la empresa sufriría.

examples.en: Come what may, I'll be there.
examples.es: Pase lo que pase, estaré allí.

sections.heading: Lest, whether… or not, so as to
body: Lest = por si, para que no (formal, con subjuntivo): He left early lest he miss the train. Whether or not expresa indiferencia ante la condición: Whether or not you agree, the decision is final. So as to / in order to expresan finalidad formal; so as not to, la negativa.

examples.en: Write it down lest you forget.
examples.es: Anótalo, no sea que lo olvides.

examples.en: Whether you like it or not, it's the law.
examples.es: Te guste o no, es la ley.

examples.en: She spoke softly so as not to wake the baby.
examples.es: Habló bajo para no despertar al bebé.

sections.tip: El subjuntivo no cambia con la persona: that he go, that she be, that it remain.

exercises.prompt: The committee recommended that the proposal ___ accepted.
exercises.explanation: Subjuntivo: forma base del verbo be.

exercises.prompt: It is essential that everyone ___ on time.
I suggest that he ___ (apologise) immediately.
answers: apologise
apologize

exercises.prompt: They demanded that she ___ (not / leave) the building.
answers: not leave

exercises.es: Pase lo que pase, estaré aquí.
Te guste o no, tenemos que irnos.
answers: Whether you like it or not, we have to leave.
Whether you like it or not, we have to go.
Whether or not you like it, we have to leave.
Whether or not you like it, we have to go.

exercises.es: Es esencial que todos estén presentes.
answers: It is essential that everyone be present.
It's essential that everyone be present.
It is essential that everybody be present.

lessons.title: Modismos y lenguaje figurado
lessons.summary: Break the ice, hit the nail on the head: lo que no se traduce palabra por palabra.

sections.heading: Modismos de conversación
body: Un modismo tiene un significado distinto del literal. Los más frecuentes aparecen en series, reuniones y charlas: break the ice (romper el hielo), hit the nail on the head (dar en el clavo), on the same page (de acuerdo), a piece of cake (pan comido), once in a blue moon (muy de vez en cuando), cost an arm and a leg (costar un ojo de la cara), under the weather (pachucho).

examples.en: Let's play a game to break the ice.
examples.es: Juguemos a algo para romper el hielo.

examples.en: You hit the nail on the head.
examples.es: Diste en el clavo.

examples.en: Are we all on the same page?
examples.es: ¿Estamos todos de acuerdo?

examples.en: That car cost an arm and a leg.
examples.es: Ese coche costó un ojo de la cara.

rows: the ball is in your court

sections.heading: Modismos del trabajo y de la vida
body: Think outside the box (pensar de forma creativa), cut corners (hacer las cosas a medias para ahorrar), go the extra mile (esforzarse más de lo exigido), in the long run (a la larga), learn the ropes (aprender cómo funciona algo), the last straw (la gota que colma el vaso), bite the bullet (afrontar lo inevitable).

examples.en: We need to think outside the box.
examples.es: Necesitamos pensar de forma creativa.

examples.en: In the long run, it will save money.
examples.es: A la larga, ahorrará dinero.

examples.en: That was the last straw.
examples.es: Esa fue la gota que colmó el vaso.

examples.en: I bit the bullet and told him the truth.
examples.es: Me armé de valor y le dije la verdad.

examples.en: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
examples.es: Ya nos ocuparemos de eso cuando llegue el momento.

examples.en: He let the cat out of the bag.
examples.es: Se le escapó el secreto.

sections.tip: Los modismos no se modifican: a piece of cake, nunca «a slice of cake» con este sentido.

sections.heading: Metáforas y lenguaje figurado habitual
body: Muchas palabras corrientes tienen un uso figurado: a flood of complaints (una avalancha de quejas), to weigh up the options (sopesar), a bright idea, a heated argument (una discusión acalorada), to shed light on (arrojar luz sobre), the heart of the matter (el meollo).

examples.en: The report sheds light on the causes.
examples.es: El informe arroja luz sobre las causas.

examples.en: They had a heated argument.
examples.es: Tuvieron una discusión acalorada.

examples.en: Let's get to the heart of the matter.
examples.es: Vayamos al meollo del asunto.

exercises.prompt: The exam was ___: I finished in twenty minutes.
Stop ___ and tell me what happened.
I only go to the cinema once in a ___ moon.
answers: blue

exercises.prompt: It's been a long day. Let's call it a ___.
answers: day

exercises.es: Diste en el clavo.
A la larga, ahorrará tiempo.
answers: In the long run, it will save time.
In the long run it will save time.
In the long run, it'll save time.

exercises.prompt: Don't worry about next year. We'll ___ when we come to it.

exercises.es: Te toca a ti decidir.
answers: The ball is in your court.
It's your call.
The ball's in your court.

lessons.title: Participios y oraciones reducidas
lessons.summary: Having finished the report, she left: condensar dos ideas en una.

sections.heading: Oraciones de participio presente
body: Un participio en -ing puede sustituir una oración con el mismo sujeto: Feeling tired, I went to bed (= Because I felt tired…). Walking home, I saw an accident (= While I was walking home…). El sujeto de las dos partes debe ser el mismo.

examples.en: Knowing the area well, she offered to guide us.
examples.es: Como conocía bien la zona, se ofreció a guiarnos.

examples.en: Looking out of the window, I noticed the snow.
examples.es: Al mirar por la ventana, me fijé en la nieve.

examples.en: Not wanting to disturb him, I left quietly.
examples.es: Como no quería molestarlo, me fui en silencio.

sections.tip: Participio colgante: Walking home, the rain started es un error (la lluvia no camina). El sujeto del participio debe ser el de la oración principal.

sections.heading: Having + participio y los participios pasados
body: Having + participio pasado marca que una acción terminó antes que la otra: Having finished the report, she left. El participio pasado solo tiene sentido pasivo: Seen from above, the city looks tiny (= When it is seen…). Built in 1900, the bridge is still in use.

examples.en: Having lost his keys, he couldn't get in.
examples.es: Como había perdido las llaves, no pudo entrar.

examples.en: Written in a hurry, the letter was full of mistakes.
examples.es: Escrita con prisa, la carta estaba llena de errores.

examples.en: Having been warned twice, he finally stopped.
examples.es: Tras haber sido advertido dos veces, por fin paró.

examples.en: Having been delayed twice, the flight finally took off.
examples.es: Tras haberse retrasado dos veces, el vuelo por fin despegó.

examples.en: Exhausted by the climb, they rested.
examples.es: Agotados por la subida, descansaron.

sections.heading: Reducir oraciones de relativo
body: La oración de relativo se acorta con un participio: The man who is talking to Ana → The man talking to Ana. The houses that were built in the 60s → The houses built in the 60s. También con infinitivo: the first person to arrive, the best place to eat.

examples.en: The people waiting outside are journalists.
examples.es: Las personas que esperan fuera son periodistas.

examples.en: The documents sent yesterday have arrived.
examples.es: Los documentos enviados ayer han llegado.

examples.en: She was the last to leave.
examples.es: Fue la última en irse.

exercises.prompt: ___ the report, she sent it to her boss.
exercises.explanation: Acción anterior y activa: having + participio.

exercises.prompt: ___ in 1850, the house needs a lot of work.
___ (not / know) what to say, I stayed silent.
answers: Not knowing

exercises.prompt: The woman ___ (talk) to the manager is my aunt.
answers: talking

exercises.es: Tras haber perdido las llaves, no pudo entrar.
Al sentirme cansada, me fui a la cama.
answers: Feeling tired, I went to bed.

exercises.prompt: ___ by the news, she sat down in silence.

exercises.es: Al no tener dinero, se quedó en casa.
answers: Having no money, he stayed at home.
Having no money, she stayed at home.
Not having any money, he stayed at home.
Not having any money, she stayed at home.

lessons.title: Precisión y matices
lessons.summary: Big, large o huge; say, tell o state: elegir la palabra exacta.

sections.heading: Sinónimos que no son iguales
body: Big es neutro y cotidiano; large es más formal y para cantidades (a large amount); huge y enormous intensifican. Say introduce palabras (he said hello), tell lleva receptor (he told me), state es formal y afirmativo, claim sugiere duda (he claims to be an expert), mention es de paso.
Walk, stroll (pasear sin prisa), march (con decisión), wander (vagar), stride (a zancadas): el verbo preciso ahorra adverbios.

examples.en: The company reported a large loss.
examples.es: La empresa comunicó una gran pérdida.

examples.en: He claims he was at home, but nobody saw him.
examples.es: Él asegura que estaba en casa, pero nadie lo vio.

examples.en: We strolled along the beach.
examples.es: Paseamos por la playa.

examples.en: She strode into the room and demanded an answer.
examples.es: Entró a zancadas en la sala y exigió una respuesta.

sections.heading: Intensificadores y gradación
body: No todo admite very: con adjetivos extremos (freezing, exhausted, furious, brilliant) se usa absolutely, utterly, completely; con los graduables (cold, tired, angry, good), very, extremely, rather, fairly. Rather suaviza; quite puede significar «bastante» o, con adjetivos extremos, «completamente» (quite impossible).

examples.en: It was absolutely freezing.
examples.es: Hacía un frío espantoso.

examples.en: I'm rather tired, to be honest.
examples.es: Estoy bastante cansado, la verdad.

examples.en: That's quite impossible.
examples.es: Eso es completamente imposible.

examples.en: The food was utterly delicious.
examples.es: La comida estaba absolutamente deliciosa.

examples.en: The hotel was fairly cheap, and the room was absolutely spotless.
examples.es: El hotel era bastante barato y la habitación estaba impecable.

examples.en: His remark was utterly ridiculous.
examples.es: Su comentario fue completamente ridículo.

sections.tip: Very freezing y very exhausted suenan mal: los adjetivos extremos ya llevan el grado dentro.

sections.heading: Lenguaje académico y preciso
body: Verbos: analyse, assess, demonstrate, indicate, imply, account for (explicar), attribute to. Nombres: evidence (incontable), findings, approach, framework. Conectores: hence, thus, thereby, whereby, notwithstanding (a pesar de, formal). Precisar: in terms of, with regard to, as opposed to.

examples.en: The data indicate a clear trend.
examples.es: Los datos indican una tendencia clara.

examples.en: This accounts for the difference in results.
examples.es: Esto explica la diferencia en los resultados.

examples.en: The method was flawed; hence, the study was repeated.
examples.es: El método era defectuoso; de ahí que se repitiera el estudio.

examples.en: Quality, as opposed to quantity, is what matters.
examples.es: La calidad, no la cantidad, es lo que importa.

exercises.prompt: She ___ me that the meeting was cancelled.
The soup was ___ delicious.
He ___ to be a doctor, but he has no degree. (afirma, con duda)
answers: claims

exercises.prompt: The evidence ___ (be) inconclusive. (evidence es incontable)
answers: is

exercises.es: Esto explica la diferencia.
Hacía un frío espantoso.
answers: It was absolutely freezing.
It was freezing.
It was utterly freezing.

exercises.prompt: The view from the top was ___ breathtaking.

exercises.es: Los resultados indican una tendencia clara.
answers: The results indicate a clear trend.
The findings indicate a clear trend.
The data indicate a clear trend.

lessons.title: Concesivas avanzadas: much as, however hard, no matter
lessons.summary: Por mucho que, por más que, pase lo que pase.

sections.heading: Much as, try as, adjetivo + as
body: Much as I admire him, I disagree (por mucho que lo admire). Try as she might, she couldn't open it (por más que lo intentó). Adjetivo + as + sujeto + verbo: Tired as I was, I kept going (cansado como estaba). Son formas literarias o enfáticas de although.

examples.en: Much as I'd like to help, I can't.
examples.es: Por mucho que me gustaría ayudar, no puedo.

examples.en: Try as they might, they never found the treasure.
examples.es: Por más que lo intentaron, nunca encontraron el tesoro.

examples.en: Strange as it may seem, he enjoys exams.
examples.es: Por extraño que parezca, disfruta con los exámenes.

sections.heading: However, whatever, no matter
body: However + adjetivo/adverbio + sujeto + verbo: However hard you try, you'll never beat him (por mucho que). Whatever, whoever, wherever, whenever: Whatever happens, stay calm. No matter + how/what/where: No matter what he says, don't believe him.

examples.en: However expensive it is, I'll buy it.
examples.es: Por caro que sea, lo compraré.

examples.en: Whoever calls, tell them I'm out.
examples.es: Quien sea que llame, dile que no estoy.

examples.en: No matter how late it is, call me.
examples.es: Por tarde que sea, llámame.

examples.en: Wherever you go, I'll follow.
examples.es: Vayas donde vayas, te seguiré.

rows: lo que sea / quien sea / donde sea

sections.heading: Even if, even though, albeit, notwithstanding
body: Even if (aunque, hipotético): Even if it rains, we'll go. Even though (aunque, real): Even though it rained, we went. Albeit (si bien, formal, + adjetivo o frase sin verbo): a good result, albeit a late one. Notwithstanding (a pesar de, muy formal) puede ir antes o después del sustantivo.

examples.en: Even if you apologise, she won't forgive you.
examples.es: Aunque te disculpes, no te perdonará.

examples.en: He accepted, albeit reluctantly.
examples.es: Aceptó, si bien a regañadientes.

examples.en: Notwithstanding the cost, the plan went ahead.
examples.es: A pesar del coste, el plan siguió adelante.

sections.tip: Even if y even though no son intercambiables: even if plantea una hipótesis; even though, un hecho.

exercises.prompt: ___ hard I try, I can't remember his name.
___ as I respect her, I think she's wrong.
___ happens, don't open the door.
Try ___ he might, he couldn't lift it.
answers: as

exercises.prompt: No ___ what you say, I won't change my mind. (matter)
answers: matter

exercises.es: Por tarde que sea, llámame.
Por extraño que parezca, le gusta el frío.
answers: Strange as it may seem, he likes the cold.
Strange as it may seem, she likes the cold.
Strange as it seems, he likes the cold.
Odd as it may seem, he likes the cold.

exercises.es: Aunque llueva, iremos.
answers: Even if it rains, we'll go.
Even if it rains, we will go.
Even if it rains we'll go.

lessons.title: Lo hipotético: it's time, would sooner, as if, as though
lessons.summary: Ya es hora de que, preferiría que, como si.

sections.heading: It's time y would rather / would sooner
body: It's (high / about) time + sujeto + pasado simple: It's time we left (ya es hora de que nos vayamos). Would rather / would sooner + sujeto + pasado simple para preferencias sobre otra persona: I'd sooner you didn't mention it. Sobre el pasado: I'd rather you hadn't told him.

examples.en: It's high time the government did something.
examples.es: Ya va siendo hora de que el gobierno haga algo.

examples.en: I'd rather we stayed in tonight.
examples.es: Preferiría que nos quedáramos en casa esta noche.

examples.en: I'd sooner you hadn't invited him.
examples.es: Habría preferido que no lo invitaras.

sections.heading: As if y as though
body: Comparan con algo irreal: He talks as if he knew everything (pasado simple para el presente irreal). She looked as though she had seen a ghost (pasado perfecto para el pasado irreal). Si la comparación puede ser real, el tiempo es normal: It looks as if it's going to rain.

examples.en: He acts as if he owned the place.
examples.es: Se comporta como si el sitio fuera suyo.

examples.en: They treated me as though I were a child.
examples.es: Me trataron como si fuera un niño.

examples.en: You look as if you haven't slept.
examples.es: Parece que no has dormido (puede ser verdad).

rows: It's time you went to bed.

sections.heading: Suppose, what if, if only y wish con could
body: Suppose / supposing / what if + pasado: What if we told them the truth? (¿y si…?). Wish / if only + could: I wish I could fly. Wish + would para quejas. Otherwise y or else expresan la alternativa hipotética: Hurry up, otherwise we'll be late.

examples.en: Suppose you won the lottery: what would you do?
examples.es: Supón que ganaras la lotería: ¿qué harías?

examples.en: If only I could speak to her once more.
examples.es: Si pudiera hablar con ella una vez más.

examples.en: Take an umbrella; otherwise you'll get soaked.
examples.es: Lleva paraguas; si no, te empaparás.

sections.tip: It's time to go (infinitivo) es neutro; it's time we went (pasado) sugiere que ya vamos tarde.

exercises.prompt: It's time you ___ a decision.
He spends money as if he ___ a millionaire.
I'd rather you ___ smoke in here.
She looked as though she ___ (see) a ghost. (irreal, pasado)
answers: had seen
'd seen

exercises.prompt: It's high time we ___ (leave).
answers: left

exercises.es: ¿Y si perdiéramos el último tren?
Ya es hora de que te vayas a la cama.
answers: It's time you went to bed.
It is time you went to bed.
It's high time you went to bed.

exercises.es: Me trata como si fuera un niño.
answers: He treats me as if I were a child.
She treats me as if I were a child.
He treats me as though I were a child.
She treats me as though I were a child.

lessons.title: Cohesión y referencia en el texto
lessons.summary: The former, the latter, respectively, hence, the above.

sections.heading: Referirse a lo ya dicho
body: The former / the latter (el primero / el último de dos mencionados), respectively (respectivamente), the above / the aforementioned (lo anterior, formal), this / that / these / those + sustantivo resumen (this approach, these findings), such (de tal tipo): Such behaviour is unacceptable.

examples.en: Tea and coffee are popular; the former in Britain, the latter in Italy.
examples.es: El té y el café son populares: el primero en Gran Bretaña, el segundo en Italia.

examples.en: Lucy and Tom are 12 and 15 respectively.
examples.es: Lucy y Tom tienen 12 y 15 años, respectivamente.

examples.en: All of the above applies to part-time staff.
examples.es: Todo lo anterior se aplica al personal a tiempo parcial.

sections.heading: Conectores de consecuencia y contraste formales
body: Hence / thus / thereby (de ahí, así, con ello), accordingly (en consecuencia), whereby (mediante el cual), conversely (a la inversa), by contrast, on the contrary (al contrario, para negar), in turn (a su vez), that is to say / namely (es decir).

examples.en: Sales fell; hence the decision to close two branches.
examples.es: Las ventas cayeron; de ahí la decisión de cerrar dos sucursales.

examples.en: The new system, whereby staff work from home, has been a success.
examples.es: El nuevo sistema, por el cual el personal trabaja desde casa, ha sido un éxito.

examples.en: It's not a failure; on the contrary, it's a first step.
examples.es: No es un fracaso; al contrario, es un primer paso.

sections.heading: Sustitución y elipsis en textos
body: Para no repetir: do so, the same, likewise, so (I think so), one(s), that/those of, el verbo omitido tras auxiliar (as they should). Likewise y similarly abren frases paralelas; the same goes for / applies to extiende una afirmación.

examples.en: The north voted against the plan; the south did likewise.
examples.es: El norte votó contra el plan; el sur hizo lo mismo.

examples.en: The same applies to foreign students.
examples.es: Lo mismo se aplica a los estudiantes extranjeros.

examples.en: Those who wish to object may do so in writing.
examples.es: Quienes deseen objetar pueden hacerlo por escrito.

sections.tip: On the contrary niega lo anterior; by contrast solo compara. No son intercambiables.

exercises.prompt: Ana and Luis study law and medicine ___.
Two options were discussed: the ___ was cheaper, the latter faster.
Demand rose; ___ the increase in prices.
It wasn't a waste of time. ___ the contrary, we learned a lot.
answers: On

exercises.prompt: Only two people came, ___ Marta and her brother. (es decir)
answers: namely

exercises.es: Lo mismo se aplica a los visitantes.
Quienes deseen participar pueden hacerlo en línea.
answers: Those who wish to participate may do so online.
Those who wish to take part may do so online.
Those wishing to participate may do so online.

exercises.es: El norte votó en contra; el sur hizo lo mismo.
answers: The north voted against; the south did likewise.
The north voted against it; the south did likewise.
The north voted against; the south did the same.

lessons.title: Binomios, colocaciones avanzadas y énfasis formal
lessons.summary: Safe and sound, by and large, the very idea, no reason whatsoever.

sections.heading: Binomios: pares fijos
body: Expresiones de dos palabras unidas por and u or, siempre en el mismo orden: safe and sound (sano y salvo), by and large (en general), sooner or later, more or less, give and take (ceder por ambas partes), odds and ends (cosas sueltas), pros and cons, wear and tear (desgaste), peace and quiet, now and then (de vez en cuando), sick and tired (harto).

examples.en: They arrived home safe and sound.
examples.es: Llegaron a casa sanos y salvos.

examples.en: By and large, the plan worked.
examples.es: En general, el plan funcionó.

examples.en: I'm sick and tired of waiting.
examples.es: Estoy harto de esperar.

examples.en: Every relationship needs some give and take.
examples.es: Toda relación necesita ceder por ambas partes.

sections.heading: Énfasis formal
body: The very + sustantivo (el mismísimo, precisamente): the very idea, at the very least. Whatsoever / at all tras un negativo: no reason whatsoever, nothing at all. In no way, by no means (de ninguna manera). Not in the least (en absoluto). Indeed refuerza: It was indeed a surprise. The + adjetivo en -est + ever: the best ever.

examples.en: The very thought of it makes me nervous.
examples.es: Solo pensarlo me pone nervioso.

examples.en: There is no evidence whatsoever.
examples.es: No hay ninguna prueba en absoluto.

examples.en: This is by no means the end.
examples.es: Esto no es, ni mucho menos, el final.

examples.en: I'm not in the least surprised.
examples.es: No me sorprende en absoluto.

sections.heading: Colocaciones avanzadas
body: Adverbio + adjetivo: bitterly disappointed, painfully shy, highly regarded, vastly overrated, blissfully unaware, perfectly reasonable. Verbo + sustantivo: strike a balance, pose a threat, draw a conclusion, foot the bill, meet a deadline, bear a resemblance to, run the risk of.

examples.en: We need to strike a balance between work and rest.
examples.es: Hay que encontrar el equilibrio entre trabajo y descanso.

examples.en: He was bitterly disappointed with the result.
examples.es: Quedó amargamente decepcionado con el resultado.

examples.en: They ran the risk of losing everything.
examples.es: Corrían el riesgo de perderlo todo.

sections.tip: Las colocaciones no se improvisan: «make a balance» no existe; se dice strike a balance.

exercises.prompt: The children came back ___.
There's no reason ___ to worry.

lessons.title: Verbos de percepción, causativos y make, let, have
lessons.summary: See him go, make him wait, let it be, get it done.

sections.heading: Verbos de percepción
body: See, hear, watch, notice, feel + objeto + verbo base (la acción completa): I saw her leave. + -ing (en curso, parcial): I saw her leaving. En pasiva, el verbo base pasa a to: She was seen to leave.

examples.en: I heard the door slam.
examples.es: Oí la puerta cerrarse de golpe.

examples.en: We watched them playing in the garden.
examples.es: Los vimos jugando en el jardín.

examples.en: He was seen to enter the building at nine.
examples.es: Se le vio entrar en el edificio a las nueve.

sections.heading: Make, let, have, get
body: Make + objeto + verbo base (obligar): They made us wait. Let + objeto + verbo base (permitir): Let him go. Have + objeto + verbo base (encargar a alguien): I'll have my assistant call you. Get + objeto + to + verbo (convencer): I got him to help. En pasiva, make lleva to: We were made to wait.

examples.en: The teacher made us rewrite the essay.
examples.es: El profesor nos hizo reescribir el ensayo.

examples.en: My parents let me stay out late.
examples.es: Mis padres me dejaron volver tarde.

examples.en: I'll have the porter bring your bags.
examples.es: Haré que el botones suba sus maletas.

examples.en: She got her brother to fix the bike.
examples.es: Consiguió que su hermano arreglara la bici.

sections.tip: Make en pasiva recupera el to: They made me sign → I was made to sign.

sections.heading: Have / get something done y get + -ing
body: Have / get + objeto + participio: que otro haga algo (We had the roof repaired) o algo que te ocurre (He had his car stolen). Get + -ing: ponerse a (Let's get going). Get + objeto + -ing: poner en marcha (She got the engine running).

examples.en: We got the documents translated.
examples.es: Hicimos traducir los documentos.

examples.en: She had her bag stolen on the train.
examples.es: Le robaron el bolso en el tren.

examples.en: It's late; let's get moving.
examples.es: Es tarde; pongámonos en marcha.

lessons.title: Puntuación y estilo en inglés
lessons.summary: Comas, punto y coma, guiones y las diferencias con el español.

sections.heading: La coma
body: Separa elementos de una lista (a veces con la coma de Oxford antes de and: red, white, and blue), oraciones subordinadas al inicio (If you're tired, rest), oraciones explicativas (My brother, who lives in Lima, …) y conectores (However, …). No se usa coma entre sujeto y verbo ni antes de that.

examples.en: After the meeting, we went for lunch.
examples.es: Después de la reunión, fuimos a almorzar.

examples.en: She said that she was tired.
examples.es: Dijo que estaba cansada (sin coma antes de that).

examples.en: We bought apples, pears and plums.
examples.es: Compramos manzanas, peras y ciruelas.

sections.heading: Punto y coma, dos puntos y guion largo
body: El punto y coma une dos oraciones completas relacionadas (The rain stopped; the sun came out) y separa elementos largos de una lista. Los dos puntos introducen una explicación o una lista (There's one problem: money). El guion largo (—) marca un inciso enfático en estilo informal o periodístico.

examples.en: I have two passions: music and cooking.
examples.es: Tengo dos pasiones: la música y la cocina.

examples.en: The results were clear; nobody argued.
examples.es: Los resultados fueron claros; nadie discutió.

examples.en: She finally arrived — two hours late.
examples.es: Por fin llegó, dos horas tarde.

sections.heading: Diferencias con el español
body: En inglés no hay signos de apertura (¿ ¡). Las mayúsculas van en días, meses, idiomas, nacionalidades y en I. Las comillas suelen ser dobles en inglés americano y la puntuación va dentro: "Come in," she said. Los números: 1,000 (miles con coma) y 3.5 (decimal con punto).

examples.en: "Where are you going?" he asked.
examples.es: «¿Adónde vas?», preguntó.

examples.en: The population is 2,500,000.
examples.es: La población es de 2.500.000.

examples.en: I speak Spanish and English.
examples.es: Hablo español e inglés (idiomas con mayúscula).

sections.tip: Its sin apóstrofo es posesivo; it's es it is o it has. Es el error de puntuación más común entre nativos.
